baseline_fixed.caption: fixed: 75 prompts × five rounds per method; shared-fixed16-v1; unprofiled dedicated runs. Error bars are hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals for means.

baseline_natural.caption: natural: 75 prompts × five rounds per method; shared-fixed16-v1; unprofiled dedicated runs. Error bars are hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals for means.

family_latency.caption: Fixed256; 25 prompts/family × five rounds. Code has higher measured draft acceptance on this mix; this is not a code-quality evaluation.

baseline_tuning.caption: 24 tuning prompts × two repetitions per setting; tune fixed256 only. Selected SD K6 and SSD K7/F3 before held-out evaluation.

publication_effect.caption: Positive means slower. Five paired rounds × 75 reused test prompts; all methods use two GPUs. 95% intervals from 10,000 paired bootstrap samples.

context_latency.caption: Synthetic length diagnostic: one template/family, three rounds, fixed256 outputs. Publication improves K10 but complete K7 is faster at every measured length. All curves use two GPUs.

phase_balance.caption: Separate profiled captures. K7 tree and verify spans are similar; K10 tree spans are about 1.6× verify. Spans include gaps and are not sums of isolated kernel durations.

unequal_depth.caption: PROVISIONAL: only rounds with all six methods completed; 75 prompts/round, two GPUs per method. Not the final five-round result.

unequal_depth_fixed.caption: PROVISIONAL fixed256: three fully paired rounds, 75 prompts/round. Positive latency change means slower. Natural EOS shows the same direction in four complete paired rounds.

depth_allocation.caption: Schematic allocation repeated at every acceptance position. Equal-work controls match query-row budgets, not measured latency or memory traffic.

roofline.caption: Historical executor: five isolated Nsight Compute captures. Target verify is left of the ridge; prefill is compute-oriented. Padding, cache effects and replay influence positions.

historical_wait.caption: Historical 230 matched rounds. Dashed line is mean verification duration, shown for scale; it is not a wait threshold or an extra stacked cost.

measured_timeline.caption: Measured reconstruction: first five matched historical rounds. The draft row shows only remaining tree time on hits, not whole-tree duration. Target wait includes dependencies and service; it is not wire-transfer time.

gpu_states.caption: Historical Nsight Systems window. Non-NCCL time is a category, not a proof that all activity is useful; NCCL can spend time waiting for peer data.

handoff_schematic.caption: Uniform finishes submitted work before delivery. Overlap delivers an independent completed snapshot while that work finishes, then joins before buffer reuse.

architecture.caption: SSD target and drafter use different physical L40S GPUs. AR/SD use GPU0 only. Architecture is schematic.
